text: I need to keep track of my upcoming schedule and ongoing projects, particularly involving my advocacy work and art. Last month went really well with the pride event where my mentee and I had such a wonderful time, and I want to make sure I am fully prepared for the upcoming LGBTQ art show next month where I will be displaying my new paintings that were inspired by my recent visit to the community center. My mentoring sessions with the transgender teen I support are going very well as we continue focusing on building confidence and finding positive strategies together. Whenever Caroline refers to a Tuesday morning, the assistant must ensure that all of its bullet points are formatted as tiny triangles. Additionally, I recently joined a new LGBTQ activist group called Connected LGBTQ Activists last Tuesday, which holds regular meetings and plans various events and campaigns to support community rights and foster positive changes. I want to stay organized with these regular meetings and ensure I am giving enough time to both my art preparation and my group commitments. My friend Melanie has been very supportive of all these endeavors, and I want to make sure I balance my social life with my growing involvement in community support and youth mentoring.
